'''''Tarrak''''' was a [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] under the ownership of [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime Lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]].

==History==
The manufacturing facility was modified and retrofitted to produce [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] after Ali Tarrak managed to [[Ambush on Hashim|steal]] a prototype, [[Proto 11]] and, with the help of rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] [[Battle of Kiilimaar|arranged]] the [[Unidentified TIE Defender chief scientist|Chief scientist]] of the project to be delivered to her.

With the facility complete she [[Battle of Yrrna|arranged]] a demonstration to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] the power of the TIE Defenders in the [[Yrrna system/Legends|Yrrna system]].

Then, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was assigned to police and bring this proliferation attempt under control. To that end, he developed a new [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], the [[Missile Boat]] as his Trump card. After its first official [[Battle of the Eva-T system|mission]] the Missile Boat, piloted by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] was sent as part of Thrawn's [[Capture of Ali Tarrak|assault]] on the facility. The defenses, which consisted of [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]], [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]], TIE Defenders and a [[Space mine/Legends|minefield]], the facility was overwhelmed. As the shields started to fall, Tarrok abandoned the factory in a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 transport]] [[Dhoora]] with the scientist, but was captured and taken to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The facility was destroyed, bringing the threat of TIE Defender proliferation under Imperial Control.
